subject: physics
title: Alpha, Beta and Gamma Decay
welcome_lead: Identify three radiations by mass, charge, range and penetrating power.
meta_desc: A-Level Nuclear adventure on properties of alpha, beta and gamma radiation.
final_note: Alpha = paper, beta = aluminium, gamma = lead — the classic stopping ladder.

concepts.def: Fast electron from n→p + e⁻ + ν̄.
High-energy photon, no charge or mass.
Alpha most, beta moderate, gamma least.
Alpha least, beta moderate, gamma most.

walkthroughs.body_html: Heavy nucleus emits ⁴₂He. Highly ionising, stopped by paper or a few cm of air. Used in smoke detectors.
β⁻: n → p + e⁻ + antineutrino, Z increases by 1. β⁺: p → n + e⁺ + neutrino, Z decreases by 1. Stopped by a few mm of aluminium.
Nucleus drops to lower energy state, emitting a γ photon. A and Z unchanged. Highly penetrating — needs thick lead or concrete to attenuate.
